full_judgment: 11. Under State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 ("the SAT Act"), the Land Survey Tribunals have been empowered to deal with very specific issues/cases. Section 145A(4) of the SAT Act provides: No suit other than the suits arising out of the final publication of the last revised record of rights prepared under section 144 shall lie in the Land Survey Tribunal.
